WSDC · Competition Results

Event Data Registry

WSDC public results = finals and points as published by WSDC. Competition Results = extended round-level data (prelims, judges, final partners) from scoring platforms.

Checklist = skill-level Jack & Jill only (Newcomer→Champions). Partners are full only when prelims exist; without prelims, at most partial.

Prelims: a division whose final was scraped but has no prelim round counts as finals-only (likely not held), not as missing data. A division known only from WSDC public results is a gap.

Software: Confirmed = Competition Results scrape source; else this edition's Results Form; else Needs check. DC redact = Dance Convention may hide competitor names.
